newsitem.title: USA: Performance Food to buy McLane unit.
newsitem.headline: Performance Food to buy McLane unit.

text.p: Performance Food Group said on Thursday a definitive agreement has been signed to purchase the assets of McLane Foodservice, a subsidiary of Wal-Mart Stores Inc for about $30 million.

McLane Foodservice, which operates distribution centers in Temple and Victoria, Texas, provides products and services to traditional foodservice accounts as well as to quick-service restaurants, healthcare providers and vending customers, Performance Food said.

Performance Food said the acquisition will boost its competitive standing and provide "a logical geographic expansion" of its operations into southwest and adds customers in Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana and Oklahoma.
Completion of the deal is subject to closing conditions, including expiration of an antitrust waiting period, Performance Food said.
Sledd said that the operations covered by the agreement should generate annualized 1996 sales of approximately $180 million. Performance Food Group reported net sales for 1995 of $664.1 million.
